title: Salty Rose Inn
meta_description: Salty Rose Inn is a bright, spacious Inlet Beach home with a porch, firepit, bunk beds, and access to 30A's beaches, shops, and the communal pool.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Salty Rose Inn, a bright and breezy beachside haven tucked into the heart of Inlet Beach. With sugar-white sand just a 10-minute walk away via newly added pedestrian beach access, and easy reach to the boutiques, cafes, and bike paths that make 30A such a beloved destination, this is your place to relax, recharge, and reconnect on the Gulf.

Inside, the home is airy and inviting, with a sunlit living room full of cozy seating, a dining table for eight, and a fully equipped kitchen ready for everything from pancake breakfasts to sunset dinners. Board games add a playful touch, while the home's thoughtful layout offers four spacious bedrooms and three full bathrooms. Sleeping arrangements include one king bed, one queen bed, one full bed, a twin-over-twin bunk, and a twin-over-full bunk---perfect for families or groups. A full laundry room and vacuum help keep things fresh after sandy beach days.

Outdoors, the charm continues with a beautiful front porch, comfortable lounge chairs, a grill, and a firepit for evenings under the stars. And when you're not beach hopping or exploring Rosemary Beach town center, Alys Beach, or Seacrest---all just a short stroll or bike ride away, unwind at the sparkling communal pool just moments from the front door.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Enjoy 2 complimentary bikes during your stay---perfect for exploring the area!
- This homes comes with a Pack'n'Play, and a booster seat.

Parking Details:
- Open parking with 2 total spaces, including uncovered spots.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
